sets.label: Cube shape
sets.description: Five star cases: restore the square shape from a layer with six corners.

sets.label: All shapes
sets.description: Every shape back to a square in one sequence, grouped by the number of slices it takes. Names give the top layer, then the bottom.

sets.label: Corner orientation
sets.description: Move corners into their correct layer.

sets.label: Edge orientation
sets.description: Separate top and bottom edges without disturbing the corners.

sets.label: Edge permutation
sets.description: Paired swaps to place the edges, then each one-look case of both layers, named top / bottom (Vandenbergh EP).

sets.label: Parity & middle layer
sets.description: Resolve an odd edge swap or restore the middle layer.

sets.label: Tips & insertions
sets.description: Align the tips and practise inserting the first-layer edges. Uppercase turns include the tip.

sets.label: Last three edges
sets.description: The five beginner last-layer cases, with the solved face down.

sets.label: Last four edges
sets.description: The last four edges in one algorithm once the V is built, grouped by how the edges sit.

sets.label: First face & corners
sets.description: Beginner corner insertions and sledgehammer sequences. Follow the displayed grip and rotations.

sets.label: Last centers
sets.description: Cycle the remaining centers after the corners are solved.

sets.label: Sarah's advanced
sets.description: Everything after the first layer in one algorithm (L2L): grouped by the top corners, then by how the centres move.

sets.label: Last four or five centers
sets.description: The corners solved, the last four or five centers in one algorithm (L4C, L5C).

sets.label: Pair insertions
sets.description: Practise corner-edge pair insertions before the last layer. Megaminx face turns are 72°, not 90°.

sets.label: Edge orientation
sets.description: Three edge-orientation cases for the last layer. Match the U face in the diagram.

sets.label: Corner orientation
sets.description: Sixteen corner-orientation cases for the four-look last layer.

sets.label: Edge permutation
sets.description: Five edge-permutation cases for the four-look last layer.

sets.label: Corner permutation
sets.description: Corner cycles and swaps to finish the last layer. BR means the back-right face.
